device_name: CD Horizon Solera 4.75mm & 5.5/6.0mm Thoracolumbar Fixation System

specs.Features: Polyaxial Head , Fixed Head , Percutaneous Screw , Self Tapping , Extended Reduction Head Tabs

description:
The CD Horizon Solera Spinal Fixation system by Medtronic is a complete thoracolumbar to pelvis fixation system that comes as a 4.75mm & 5.5/6.0mm rod system. The system makes use of Titanium and Cobalt chrome components for added stability. Used in degenerative as well as deformity, tumor, trauma, and MIS surgeries. This is a non-modular system. Each screw is available in both the 4.75mm rod system as well as the larger 5.5/6.0mm rod system.
